tests.name: detects-always-pattern
tests.description: Should detect an 'always' preference and acknowledge saving it
tests.prompt: Always use const instead of let when the variable is not reassigned

tests.name: detects-never-pattern
tests.description: Should detect a 'never' preference and acknowledge saving it
tests.prompt: Never push to main without asking me first

tests.name: detects-remember-pattern
tests.description: Should detect 'Remember:' as a preference signal and capture the detail
tests.prompt: Remember: our API runs on port 3001

tests.name: ignores-past-tense
tests.description: Should NOT treat past tense 'never' as a preference
tests.prompt: I never used var in my old projects, it was always let

tests.name: ignores-questions
tests.description: Should NOT treat questions as preferences
tests.prompt: Should I always use strict mode in TypeScript?

tests.name: confirms-medium-confidence
tests.description: Should ask for confirmation on medium-confidence 'I prefer' patterns
tests.prompt: I prefer tabs over spaces for indentation

assertions.value: (?i)(want me to remember|save this|remember this|noticed a.*(preference|preference))

tests.name: responds-to-show
tests.description: Should display preferences when asked to show them

tests.name: categorizes-git-preferences
tests.description: Should categorize git-related preferences under Git & Version Control
tests.prompt: Always create a feature branch before starting new work
